basis: Q4 beat the top of May guidance on every line. Bookings were $1.5bn (3.3x book-to-bill) and backlog $3.0bn (+256%). FY27 guidance of $2.4-2.6bn revenue and $575-625m EBITDA (+86%) is described as significantly above the IPO forecast, and capacity is being added. That is a strong upside surprise for a recent data-center IPO.
